scope: Mind & Perception presell and independent evidence only

claims.statement: Zen12 describes 12-minute sessions
claims.qualification: Product feature only

claims.statement: Zen12 presents 12 levels
claims.qualification: Exact SKU must be checked

claims.statement: The seller offers four audio versions per level
claims.qualification: Seller description, not efficacy

claims.statement: The separate full-course promotional page lists 48 MP3s
claims.qualification: Different offer surfaces may have different terms

claims.statement: Zen12 'meditates for you'
claims.qualification: No product-specific controlled evidence authenticated

claims.statement: 12 minutes of Zen12 equals an hour of conventional meditation
claims.qualification: No matched clinical or objective equivalence trial found

claims.statement: Brainwave sounds automatically induce a particular state
claims.qualification: Named product-specific EEG and outcome substantiation not obtained

claims.statement: Zen12 cures anxiety or depression
claims.qualification: No evidence authenticated and no such editorial recommendation

claims.statement: Zen12 increases income, productivity or wealth
claims.qualification: No product-specific proof; not implied by task-choice exercise

claims.statement: Official Zen12 main and coupon pages show distinct offer presentations
claims.qualification: Do not transplant visible promotional price, code or terms into a referred offer

claims.statement: The public affiliate signup means Final Vestige is an approved partner
claims.qualification: Public enrollment is not named acceptance

claims.statement: Final Vestige has an issued eligible tracking URL
claims.qualification: No authenticated earning link or channel rights

claims.statement: Thirteen minutes daily for 8 weeks of guided meditation improved selected outcomes versus podcast listening
claims.qualification: Specific intervention; reported after 8 not 4 weeks; not Zen12

claims.statement: The Basso study establishes a guaranteed 12-minute threshold
claims.qualification: 13 not 12; limited design and population; no guarantee

claims.statement: Ten versus twenty-minute single session did not show a general difference in state mindfulness
claims.qualification: Not an equivalence trial, 12 minutes and hour not tested

claims.statement: 10- and 20-minute meditation are equivalent for every outcome
claims.qualification: Null difference in some outcomes not equivalence

claims.statement: A 2024 review included 111 randomized trials and 9,538 participants
claims.qualification: Multiple interventions; exclude one-session studies

claims.statement: Mindfulness interventions improved processing speed and episodic memory reliably
claims.qualification: Meta-analysis did not find significant improvements in these domains

claims.statement: Research on mindfulness validates the commercial Zen12 soundtrack
claims.qualification: Named product not tested

claims.statement: FV Focus Fieldbook is a free 52-page established resource
claims.qualification: Do not create second subscription or imply Fieldbook is clinically tested

claims.statement: FV Puységur archive includes historical testimony, failures and consent context
claims.qualification: No inference of animal-magnetism mechanism

claims.statement: An affiliate disclosure only in the site's footer suffices for a paid recommendation
claims.qualification: Put clear material relationship disclosure adjacent to specific earning link

claims.statement: A product's mental or health benefit requires adequate substantiation
claims.qualification: Competent reliable scientific evidence pertinent to named product and claim

claims.statement: An outbound affiliate_click is a confirmed paid transaction
claims.qualification: Merchant order and settlement evidence required separately

claims.statement: Product price and refund terms are fixed across Zen12 offer surfaces
claims.qualification: Require approved referred checkout snapshot and verified refund policy

claims.statement: Hypnosis Live Total Focus and Brainwave Shots Focus Shot are described by seller websites
claims.qualification: No specific efficacy or affiliate rights claimed; not active conversion SKUs

claims.statement: The live change-blindness URL is a current usable archive destination
claims.qualification: Do not duplicate article or invent Grok asset ID

claims.statement: A first-party paid order can be attributed without qualified session or settlement evidence
claims.qualification: Net revenue/1000 requires both real net revenue and denominator
